items.title: Introducing the data engineering agent for Fabric (Project Osmos)
items.excerpt: AI coding assistants are excellent at turning natural-language transformation instructions into code. For data engineers, the harder question is whether that code produces results they can trust. You can describe transformation logic in natural language, and an AI coding assistant will happily generate hundreds of lines of Spark code. Impressive. But a Spark job can execute successfully and still produce completely wrong results. The logic may work for a subset of the data but fail when run against the full dataset. The pipeline's logic and validation checks may not account for future changes to the data or schema. Incremental loads can cause duplicates. Revenue numbers might look perfectly reasonable until someone reconciles them against the source. Anyone who's spent time working with real-world enterprise data knows that automating data engineering with AI comes with a unique set of challenges. Data engineering involves more than code: it requires working with large datasets and retaining context about their schemas, relationships, and business rules over time. items.title: From a prompt to an operational dashboard: Generate Real-Time Dashboards with Copilot (Preview)
items.excerpt: Start with the question, not a blank dashboard Which transit stations are sending the most fans toward a stadium? How does that incoming demand compare with activity at the gates? Where are queues building? Answering these operational questions traditionally requires translating them into tables, queries, visualizations, and a dashboard layout. When you already know what you want to monitor, that setup can get in the way of the question you are trying to answer. Copilot in Microsoft Fabric can generate a Real-Time Dashboard from a natural-language description of the insights you want. Working with a selected database in an Eventhouse, it uses the tables in that database to create a dashboard tailored to your goal. Figure: Start generating a Real-Time Dashboard with Copilot from an Eventhouse database . Rather than beginning with an empty canvas and building each visual separately, you describe the operational view you need. Copilot helps create the initial dashboard, and you review and customize it for your team.
